system.description: A key of red, flaking iron that the Tidemongers say opened Caraz's first temple before it crumbled. Once per day, as ◈, touch a lock, chain or metal object: it rusts through and gives way. Against a foe in metal armour, make a melee attack (Strength DR12) instead. Success: its armour drops one tier until the encounter ends. Failure: no effect. Ruin: your own weapon rusts; Bane on attacks with it until you spend a Short Rest cleaning it. Expendable d20.
system.lastRite: ◈ Turn it in the air and snap it: every lock, chain and bar within 30' gives way, and all metal armour within 30', yours included, drops to no armour until repaired.
system.drawback: Change turns on you: the next time you roll a natural 1 with a weapon, it breaks.
